title: Network Participation Agreements: Tenure Relief on Withholdings from Claim Payment Runs
content:
Long-standing network participants under the **Network Participation Agreements** whose agreements are paid by claim payments have the continuing run withholding share relieved. The relief grows with the agreement's tenure.

**Clause.** The run tenure relief to the continuing run withholding share is set by the whole months from the agreement's effective date to today:

| Whole months in force | Share points subtracted |
|---|---|
| 96 or more | 15 |
| 48 or more but fewer than 96 | 8 |
| Fewer than 48 | Nothing |

## Counting whole months

Whole months are the difference in calendar months between the effective date shown on the agreement record and today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the effective date's day of the month.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Effective 15 August, year 1; today 15 August, year 5: 48 whole months, so 8 points are subtracted.
- Effective 16 August, year 1; today 15 August, year 5: 47 whole months, so nothing is subtracted.
- Effective 1 February, year 1; today 28 February, year 9: 96 whole months, so 15 points are subtracted.
